coreAttributes.name: transformation bracelet
coreAttributes.description:
A metal bracelet with an elegant design that fits comfortably around the wearer's wrist, with a glowing heart-shaped gem affixed on it. You feel like you must fight against your opponent, no matter what!
Remove the bracelet to de-transform.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(tap)] the jewel in the middle of the bracelet. With a flash of light, [npc.her] clothes return to normal.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(tap)] the jewel in the middle of [npc2.namePos] bracelet. With a flash of light, [npc2.her] clothes return to normal.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] forcefully [npc.verb(tap)] the jewel in the middle of [npc2.namePos] bracelet. With a flash of light, [npc2.her] clothes forcefully return to normal.
